rotating_reviews: “I’ve never skiied or snowboarded in my life and Basil was the perfect instructor!! He’s very patient, explains things very well and I felt 100% safe with him going straight to a blue run.” Charleigh Whole review

“Basil is a fantastic snowboard instructor! I booked three half-day lessons. He helped me improve my technique, taught me how to carve, and showed me some cool on-piste tricks. Thanks, Basil, see you next time!” Silvan Ammann
“Basil is an excellent and patient snowboard instructor and has built a really cool snowboard school. Definitely recommended for anyone if snowboarding is on their bucket list ☺️🙌” Selina Flühler
“I was looking for a snowboard instructor in Engelberg for my sons online. Luckily, I found Basil. I booked three days. Basil is very professional and friendly.” Julio Pinto Whole review
“We booked a beginner's snowboarding lesson for our daughter at Bluebird Snowsports in Engelberg and were very satisfied.” Andreas Steffen Whole review
“Amazing snowboarding lesson in Engelberg with Basel! I booked a 2-hour private session and it was the best coaching experiences I’ve had on the slopes.” Ryan Padley Whole review

“We had such a fantastic experience with Basil at Bluebird in Engelberg! He taught my three kids over three days, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better instructor.” Hans NorthRider Whole review

“My colleague said he could teach me to snowboard, but as it turned out, that wasn't the case. To avoid falling on my backside again, I decided to get a snowboard instructor.” liam rohner Whole review
“Amazing snowboard instructor! Basil is a super cool guy with tons of experience. He really knows how to shred the slopes and explain things in a clear, motivating way.” Sacha Meier Whole review
